## Changes

### New
- Covers fly from the lists into a comic's page and back.
- Explore and Bookmarks give the comics more room: the header slides away while you scroll down and comes back as soon as you scroll up. Explore's header is also shorter, with the filter button at the end of the quick filters.
- A comic's actions (merge sources, migrate, WebView, share) are in one ⋮ menu.
- A comic's page shows its score as a tile when the source has one; the status moves next to the source.
- Smaller screen titles.

### Fixes
- The selected chapter count no longer breaks over three lines.
- Bookmarks: the header comes back when you switch tabs.
- Menus line up under their button.
